name: Hyrule Castle B1 north of Zelda west

points.label: east_extent
points.notes: West-corridor east bound; wrap from east pocket also lands x=688 y=3960

points.label: second_key_pin
points.notes: CastleB1SecondKey; keys=1 in east alcove (chest + pots). Cardinals box x=832-944 y=3976-4008; LEFT at pin y is the south jamb.

points.label: east_pocket_nw
points.notes: NW lip inside the alcove. Cardinal LEFT stays (832,3982). UP along this x reaches (835,3944) still east of the corridor.

points.label: east_pocket_west_door
points.notes: West door of the east alcove. Open at y=3960; pin y=3988 hits the jamb. UP+LEFT from east_pocket_nw walks through (no key spent).

points.label: wrap_to_corridor
points.notes: UP+LEFT from east_pocket_nw halt; x=east_extent keys=1. Then south_door_approach DOWN → 0x81.

doors.label: south_to_0x81
doors.notes: Measured ~180f DOWN from landing back to 0x81. CastleB1SecondKey wrap (east_pocket_nw UP+LEFT → wrap_to_corridor) then DOWN: room-change (632,4084) sub=2, settle 0x81 (632,4155) keys=1.

notes: No dedicated save-state for the west corridor; measured by UP from CastleZeldaB1West.
0x70 north stairs settle at (672,3658). CastleB1SecondKey (904,3988) is the east alcove (keys=1).
East pocket wrap: NW lip UP+LEFT through west door at y=3960 → wrap_to_corridor (688,3960) keys=1, then south_to_0x81. Cardinal LEFT at pin y=3988 is the jamb (keys stay 1).
North/west/east bounds measured; no F1 door isolated in this room.
